# Phase 7 — Deferred Items

Out-of-scope discoveries during plan execution. Per the executor deviation rules, these are not auto-fixed by Phase 7 plans.

## D-1 — Pre-existing webui embed build failure

**Discovered:** 2026-05-07 during 07-03 execution.

**Symptom:** `go build ./...` fails with:

```
internal/client/webui/embed.go:9:12: pattern all:static: no matching files found
```

**Root cause:** `internal/client/webui/embed.go` uses `//go:embed all:static` to ship the SvelteKit build output, but the `static/` subdirectory is generated by an out-of-tree build step (`web/server-ui/.../npm run build` followed by a copy step) that is not run as part of `go build`.

**Why deferred:** Pre-existing on the base commit (`7154943` — phase 7 wave 1 merge). Verified by git-stashing the Phase 7-03 changes and re-running `go build ./...`; the same error reproduces. Not introduced by 07-03 and not in the 07-03 file scope.

**Workaround used during 07-03:** Build/test only the directly-affected packages — `go build ./internal/server/... ./cmd/trasker-server/...` — which all build cleanly. CGO_ENABLED=0 also clean for the server-side packages.

**Suggested owner:** Phase 4 (web frontend) or whichever phase introduces the deploy bundling step.
